extracted.intended_audience: general readers, journalists, researchers, and developers interested in fact-checking platforms and news-credibility tools
extracted.subtask_description: Extracts and enumerates the components and scoring approach used by the Our.News "nutrition labels" (Newstrition) for rating the reliability of news articles, including what information was displayed and how scores were produced.

rubrics_metrics.name: Nutrition Labels for News (Newstrition)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provided "nutritional labels" combining automated and user-assigned scores to rate the reliability of news articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Labels were aimed to combat online misinformation by providing a condensed breakdown of the background ingredients and information that make up any news article; branded also as Newstrition. (Platform inactive since July 20, 2023.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Publisher information
rubrics_metrics.description: Included info about the publisher as part of the label.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Publisher details were one of the background 'ingredients' shown on the nutrition label to help assess source reliability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Author information
rubrics_metrics.description: Included info about the author as part of the label.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Author metadata on the label helped users evaluate who wrote the piece and their credibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editor information
rubrics_metrics.description: Included info about the editor as part of the label.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Editor details were provided to give additional context about editorial oversight for the article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Third-party fact checks
rubrics_metrics.description: Included third-party fact checks as part of the label.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The label surfaced any relevant external fact-checking results to inform the article's accuracy assessment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Article sources
rubrics_metrics.description: Included the article's sources as part of the label.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listing the article's cited sources aimed to show the basis for claims and enable assessment of evidentiary support.

rubrics_metrics.name: AI article classifications
rubrics_metrics.description: Included AI article classifications as part of the label.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Automated classifiers provided machine-generated categorizations or flags about the article (e.g., likely misinformation or other labels) to augment human judgement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public opinion ratings
rubrics_metrics.description: Included public opinion ratings as part of the label.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Crowd- or public-sourced ratings were shown to reflect broader user perceptions of the article's reliability or trustworthiness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Crowdsourced factchecking
rubrics_metrics.description: Offered crowdsourced factchecking as a service component.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users could contribute assessments (user-assigned scores) which were combined with automated signals to form the label; the platform operated via a browser extension and mobile app with optional registration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Combined automated and user-assigned scoring
rubrics_metrics.description: Relied on a combination of automated signals and user-assigned scores to compute reliability ratings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The hybrid scoring approach mixed machine classifications (AI) with crowd-sourced/human inputs to produce the nutrition label's overall assessment.
